$comment: Local IPC only. Direction: Swift to Rust. The answer to a needs-a-category card, or a tap on its reminder. Either response answers every entry that card covered (the ones it counted, and those listed below them while it was the latest card), even after the list has moved on, so the card stays away until an entry no answer has reached is among those it would count; opened also ends a run of unopened reminders. An id Rust holds no card for answers no entry. Answering only ever reduces what Velvt asks. Answered with category_prompt, which never carries a notification in reply to this message.
title: AcknowledgeCategoryPrompt

prompt_id.description: The prompt_id of the card being answered, from the latest category_prompt.

response.description: opened: the list was opened from the card or the reminder. not_now: the card was closed.
